spans.s: (opunati,) caus. opunāpayati (Pali opunāti, opunāpeti; cf. Skt. nakhāvapūta, MS only, pw 〔7.351〕), (winnows;) caus., causes to be winnowed: Mv 〔iii.178.5〕 (prose) (dhānyajātāni …) khaladhāneṣu (mss. ˚hāneṣu, q.v.) samhārāpayitavyāni opunāpayitavyāni (gdve.).
Opura (for Avapura), n. of a son of King Sujāta Ikṣvāku: Mv 〔i.348.11〕; 〔352.9.11〕.
